name: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr.
note: Starting point of the line. Raised by his grandparents, Steve and Joan (Ahn 4 and Ahn 5), by his own statement, which he gave as public (S-000-25). His raw DNA file and his grandfather's share one Y chromosome and about a fifth of their DNA in long pieces: grandfather and grandson (D-016-17, H-097).

name: Kevin John Duska
note: Born in Montréal by his son's statement (S-000-5). That puts his father, Ahn 4, in Montréal by 1962. A Québec statistical return of marriage of 1984 names his father as Steve Duska, born in Czechoslovakia, who also signs as a witness (S-249; image held). The link to Ahn 4 no longer rests on a statement alone. The bride of 1984 was Lyne Lefebvre, born in Montréal in 1964, Kevin's mother, who has died by his statement (S-000-10). She is named here as his wife; her own line is outside this rebuild. Named as the grandson Kevin in Mike Duska's death notice of 1974 (D-006-20).
living_basis: Kevin does not know whether his father is living (ledger v8, X-016). Shown by name and year only.

name: Štefan (Stefan, Steve) Duska
note: Son of Michal Duska, Roman Catholic cottar of Senné, and Maria Demko, Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce, by a sealed parish certificate of 1947. Born in Slovakia, not in Canada. Known as Steve. He left Iňačovce with his mother in November 1937, aged 8, on her passport, and sailed from Antwerp for Montréal to join his father (S-252 to S-254). Three papers of 1937 give his birthday as 23 October 1929; the parish certificate has 21 October, which is kept here as the church's own entry. In 1984 he is 'Steve Duska, born in Czechoslovakia' (S-249). Married Joan Teresa Leonard at St. Dominic's Church, Montréal, on 26 November 1955; then a superintendent, living at 5218A Des Érables (D-006-22, image held). A second parish extract of his baptism was issued at Senné on 1 October 1955 (D-006-21). Died in Montréal on 6 June 2018 aged 88; funeral at St-Brendan's, Rosemont Boulevard, on 27 June; to be interred at Notre-Dame-des-Neiges (D-015-01, the obituary, written by the owner). If he lies there he is the third of the 'three Duskas' the cemetery has on its books (D-014-08). Work: superintendent in 1955, machinist in [1957], letter carrier in [1968]; he retired from the postal service. On the index to arrivals of 1937 he is 'Stephan', 8, on page 263 with his mother (D-015-02). The obituary prints his birthday as 21 September; the owner, who wrote it, says that is his slip for October (S-000-19). So the family kept the 21st of October, the parish's date, and not the 23rd of the 1937 papers. The civil register of births, volume 5, page 102, entry 57 of 1929, kept at Palín, has him born on 23 October (D-015-11, an extract of 2005); the parish has the 21st (H-095). His brother Michael died on 14 June 2019 (D-015-15). A raw DNA file the owner calls his shares the owner's Y chromosome at every marker read and about a fifth of his DNA: his grandson's grandfather by blood (D-016-17, H-097).
living_basis: Died on 6 June 2018 by the obituary his grandson wrote (D-015-01).

baptism.place: Roman Catholic parish church, Senné (register vol. IV, p. 110, entry 43)

residence.place: Montréal, no. 5218A (voters' list; street from the marriage form)
Montréal, no. 5520 on a numbered avenue of Rosemont (voters' list; H-092)

burial.place: Notre-Dame-des-Neiges cemetery, Montréal (by the obituary; the plot is not stated)

name: Joan Teresa Leonard
note: Wife of Stephen (Štefan) Duska by the registration of their marriage, Montréal, 26 November 1955. Entered by name only; her own line is outside this rebuild (ruling X-022) and nothing else from the record is used. Dead before 6 June 2018 by her husband's obituary. On the voters' lists of [1957] and [1968] she is at his address (D-015-03, D-015-04). Her own line stays outside this rebuild.
living_basis: Her husband's obituary of June 2018 says she died before him (D-015-01).

name: Michal (Mihály, Mike) Duska
note: Born 3 July 1903 at Senné, house 79, son of András Duska, cottar, and Anna Nyemcsik (baptism D-009-79). Identified by the census of 1930: his wife Maria and son Štefan are entered at Senné 145 as the daughter-in-law and grandson of Andrej Duška and Anna, married 18 January 1892 (D-011-24). Married Maria Demko on 30 January 1927 by that census. Roman Catholic cottar of Senné 160 in 1929. Sailed for Canada aged 26, with Mikulas Duska, between November 1929 and July 1930 (D-006-19); naturalised 22 April 1940; at 1196a St. George Street, Montréal, in 1937, when he sent for his family; 'Mike Duska' on his wife's stone; alive in November 1966. Died at the Montreal General Hospital on 31 January 1974, 'age 71'; funeral from the Slovak church of St. Cyril and Method; buried in Côte-des-Neiges cemetery (D-006-20). The notice names two sons, Steve and Mike. The cemetery received him on 4 February 1974, into his wife's plot: Notre-Dame-des-Neiges, section TR, concession 6650 (D-013-101). No burial of the Mihály born in 1903 is in the Senné book to 1924; the Mihály Duska who died there in 1915 aged 3 is a son of János (D-013-182). His baptism is in hand on its full page: Senné Roman Catholic baptisms, page 203, entry 33 of 1903 (D-014-07). The Québec death index has him as Michael, born 2-7-1903, a day before the register's date, widower, died 31-1-1974, with parents 'Joseph' and 'E.', which is an error against three original records (D-015-09, H-093).

burial.place: Notre-Dame-des-Neiges cemetery, Montréal: section TR, concession 6650

name: Maria Demko (Mary Demko)
note: Wife of Michal Duska and mother of Štefan by the 1947 certificate; Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce. Died at Montréal on 9 September 1950 by her husband's declaration of 1966. Stone: born 1906, died 1950. Her parents are the Demko agent's to establish: it has Mihály Demkó and Mária Kocsis (DM P-018, P-019 @57861ad). Her emigrant passport of 1937 gives her birth as 22 August 1906 at Iňačovce and her occupation as farmer; she left in November 1937 with her son. The census of 1930 has her at Senné 145 in her father-in-law's house, married 30 January 1927, with a birth date of 15 August 1907 that disagrees with her passport. Her state birth registration, no. 45 of 1906 at Alsókánya, is read here too (D-X01-04): daughter of Mihály Demkó, born at Magasrév, aged 24, and Mária Kocsis, born at Solymos, aged 20. Notre-Dame-des-Neiges cemetery received her on 11 September 1950: section TR, concession 6650 (D-013-99). The Québec death index has her as Mary Demko, born 22-8-1906, died 9-9-1950, spouse Duska (D-015-08).

burial.place: Notre-Dame-des-Neiges cemetery, Montréal: section TR, concession 6650

name: András (Andrej) Duska
note: Roman Catholic servant, then cottar and day-labourer of Senné: houses 73, 92, 79, 98, 138 and, in 1930, 145. Married Anna Nyemcsik on 18 January 1892. Father of Michal by the census of 1930 and the baptism of 1903. Could not read or write. Son of György Duska and Anna Krak by his marriage entry (D-006-03). A death date of 22 August 1940 is noted beside a baptism of [1868] with those parents (D-009-06); the day of that baptism is not on the strip. At his marriage in 1892 he was living at Hrabó, a farmstead of Senné. Eight of his children are in the burial book between 1893 and 1918 (FG-49).

name: Anna Nyemcsik (Nemčíková; written Minarcsin and Nyemecz)
note: Wife of András Duska from 18 January 1892; twelve children, nine living in 1930. Her birth date in the census is the date of the baptism of Anna, daughter of János Nyemcsik and Erzsébet Hresko, in the Senné register (H-051). She could read. The registers show thirteen children, eight of them buried by 1918 (FG-49); the census figures above are to be read again.

name: György Duska (the elder)
note: Roman Catholic cottar of Senné, house 6, from [1866]; called 'the elder' from 1875. Named as the father of the groom András Duska in the marriage entry of 18 January 1892. Children by Anna Krak from [1866] to [1875]; a second wife, Mária Kozej, by 1880 (H-052). His own birth and parents are not known; whether he came from Solymos is hypothesis H-057. Greek Catholic Duskas were at Szenna a generation before him: Joannes (d. 1830 aged 61) and a Maria, widow of Georgius (d. 1874 aged 65), who may be his mother (H-079, H-080). His burial is in hand (B-050): György Duska, 'who was the husband of Mária Kozej', died at Ungszenna 3 on 5 January 1908 aged 74 (D-013-138). That the widower of Kozej is the husband of Anna Krak is H-052, now at 80. The house he lived in held two older Duskas: György, born about 1803, and János, born about 1798. György's first wife, Mária Béres, died in the 1840s aged 31; that they are his parents is H-085.

name: Anna Krak
note: Greek Catholic. Named as the mother of the groom in the marriage entry of 1892, with her place of origin after her name: Tiba, today Tibava near Sobrance (H-094). I first read the word as 'I[sk]e', then as 'Deba'; the owner's hired translator read Tiba, and on an enlargement it is Tiba (B-057). Mother of György Duska's children from [1866] to [1875]. Two baptisms of an Anna Krak in 1848 are candidates for hers, at Sztára and at Jesztreb (H-055, 20; H-056, 35); neither is attached. One of the two is now out: the Jesztreb Anna died on 8 December [1848] at about eight weeks (D-013-36). Three girls named Anna Krak with a father János died at Jesztreb as children, in [1836], [1847] and [1848]. No burial for her in the Senné Roman Catholic book (B-050); she was Greek Catholic. Her last child, Maria, was born on 7 August 1875 and died on the 22nd. The 'Anna Krak 1921' of the owner's files is Anna Král[y] of Rebrin, aged 30 (D-013-116).

name: János Nyemcsik
note: Roman Catholic cottar of Senné, house 79 ([1866] to 1872), then 77. Named as the father of the bride in the marriage entry of 1892 and of Anna in her baptism of 24 August 1872. Several men of this name lived at Senné; this one is fixed by his wife.

name: Erzsébet Hresko, alias Minarcsin
note: Named as the mother of the bride in the marriage entry of 1892 and of Anna in 1872. Two baptisms write her 'Hresko alias Minarcsin'; her daughter is entered as Anna Minarcsin at her own children's baptisms in the 1890s.
